constraints: Evaluate based on experience and communication skills
agents.goal: Assess the candidate's suitability for the legal position
agents.name: Interviewer

constraints: Answer questions without prior knowledge of the interviewer's expectations
agents.goal: Demonstrate competence and secure the job
agents.name: Candidate

constraints: Provide feedback on the candidate's performance
agents.goal: Ensure the hiring process adheres to company standards
agents.name: Recruiter

causes.hypothesis: Clear and structured responses improve the candidate's chances of receiving a job offer
causes.name: Communication clarity

causes.hypothesis: Candidates with relevant legal experience are more likely to be offered the job
causes.name: Legal experience

causes.hypothesis: Higher confidence during the interview correlates with a greater likelihood of receiving a job offer
causes.name: Confidence level

interaction.stopping_rule: The interaction stops after the recruiter provides feedback on the candidate's performance.

outcome.measurement_question: Did the candidate receive a job offer?
outcome.name: Job offer
outcome.operationalization: Whether the candidate receives a job offer after the interview

scenario: A person is interviewing for a job as a lawyer
